|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-7821822">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual25-Light/large/letskeepalittleoptimismherev.gif</code> as published 7 August 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/letskeepalittleoptimismherev.gif holotable commit 7821822] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Plays on table. Do They Have A Code Clearance? does not modify forfeit values. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains, and your Force drains may not be reduced.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025: “Plays on table. Do They Have A Code Clearance? does not modify forfeit values. While you occupy a Renegade planet location, operatives are forfeit = 0, operatives do not add to Force drains, and your Force drains may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II) (V)]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Let’s Keep A Little Optimism Here (Death Star II)”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
